behavior: A profile shows its money truthfully: balances and activity API
acceptance: GET /v1/profiles/{id}/balances returns per enabled chain and token the wallet balance at the second RPC's finalized block, pending and held amounts as separate fields, and an estimated USD total marked estimated; tested on Anvil
GET /v1/profiles/{id}/activity lists invoices and deposits newest first with cursor pages and an empty list for a new profile; both routes are owner-only and in openapi.yaml
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Balances and activity API meet R-33. Review fixes verified: per-chain lock, failed picks remembered 30 s, parallel per-token reads with own timeout, cancelled requests keep shared clients, pending documented truthfully incl. settlement overlap, activity 401 test. go test -race ./internal/... ./cmd/... passes; gofmt and vet clean.

proof.1: backend: internal/balance TestBalancesOnAnvil reads the wallet at Anvil's finalized block (a later unfinalized transfer is not counted), pending 1.0 detected + 2.0 owed, held 1.0, estimated 2.50 USD, only enabled tokens, no balance or total when the wallet is missing or the RPC fails; TestHungChainLeavesTheOthers and cmd/api balances tests keep one hung chain from blanking or slowing the others; httpapi TestGetBalances checks the JSON; e2e gate reads 5.00 USD through the real api on Anvil
proof.2: backend: internal/activity TestListNewestFirstInPages pages at every size (1-5) through invoices and deposits newest first with no skip or repeat, reorged and other profiles left out, empty for a new profile; httpapi TestGetActivity (pages, 400/401/422); TestProfilesBelongToTheirUser covers balances and activity (403 for another user); openapi.yaml passes redocly lint

review.summary: Balances and activity API meet R-33.
